title: Spend the day on profit that remains
summary: Real profit is not accumulation; it is the heart returning to Naam, service, and truth while breath is still here.
takeaway: Let one concrete act today earn the kind of profit ego cannot counterfeit.
lifeApplication: When aimlessness starts thinning the day, let one concrete act answer why this body and breath were given.

source.shortMeaning: The profit of human life is Naam, service, and truthful return.
source.lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as a given chance.

evidence.coreClaim: The profit of human life is Naam, service, and truthful return.
evidence.turn: The shabad ends by naming remembrance of the Fearless One as the greater profit.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one concrete act today earn the kind of profit ego cannot counterfeit.
